# v2.45-dev Release Notes

## Six more report tables now page on the server

The **Currently Expired** and **Learner Achievement Scorecard** reports already
compute their totals on the server and hand the browser one page of rows at a
time. This release brings that same treatment to the six remaining
detail-heavy reports, so opening one no longer downloads the entire dataset and
builds a giant table in the browser.

### Changed

- **Server-side pagination on six reports.** These reports now fetch one page of
  rows at a time and compute their charts, KPI cards, filter options and group
  subtotals on the server:
  - **By Product Type**
  - **By Function**
  - **Expiring Soon**
  - **Achievement Over Time**
  - **Legacy Replacement Gap**
  - **Trained But Not Certified**

  Each table now shows the standard pager used everywhere else — a
  **Show [N] records** selector with **Showing X to Y of N** and numbered page
  buttons.

- **Same look, same numbers.** Filtering, searching, column sorting, grouping
  (Theatre / Region / Country) with subtotals, the charts, and the chart-click
  filters all behave exactly as before — they're just calculated on the server
  now. Group headers and subtotals still appear at the right places within each
  page.

- **Exports still cover everything.** Exporting a report (CSV / Excel / PDF)
  still includes the **full filtered set**, not just the page you're looking at.

### Why

On instances with a lot of completions these reports could be slow to open and
heavy on the browser, because the whole training-records dataset was downloaded
and every row was rendered at once. Moving the work to the server — behind the
same short-lived result cache the other reports use — keeps the page responsive
no matter how large the dataset grows.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- Nothing changes about what the reports show or how you interact with them.
